signedMessage.message: Burnticker operator statement, signed by the developer fee wallet {PUBKEY}. I am the operator of burnticker.com and the burn_receipts and pair_curve programs. The wallets listed at https://burnticker.com/burnticker/operator are mine. The platform never buys any coin launched through it, and neither do I. Date: {DATE}.
signedMessage.how: Sign the exact text (with {PUBKEY} and {DATE} filled in) as a raw message from the developer fee wallet in Phantom (Settings → sign message is not exposed; use any dapp's signMessage, or `solana sign-offchain-message` with the CLI), paste the base58 signature into `signature`, and set `status` to the date. GET /api/burnticker/v1/operator then verifies it with ed25519 and the page shows ✓.

neverBuys.rule: None of the wallets above ever acquires a coin launched through the platform. The monitor lists every token account those wallets hold and every recent transaction in which one of them gained a platform coin.
neverBuys.rehearsalNote: On devnet the rehearsal itself traded on the curves (the keeper and the payer bought and sold test coins to prove fee routing and sell-back). Those trades are listed as explained, each with the evidence file that records it; on mainnet any acquisition is a red status line.
